files.README.md:
# vetbill

Invoicing backend for the clinics of the chain.

`npm test` runs the suite.

## Tax categories

- consultation: 22%
- medication: 10%
- pet food: 22%
- boarding: 22%

files.docs/numbering.md:
# Invoice numbering

## Per-clinic sequences

Each clinic keeps its own counter, reset every 1 January.
Numbers look like `CA-2026-0042` so front desks can tell their own invoices apart.

events.message: feat(numbering): counter per clinic and year

events.ref: chat 2026-03-10: one invoice sequence for the whole chain, as the accountant asked

steps.title: Invoice numbering shared across the chain

files.docs/numbering.md:
# Invoice numbering

## Legal sequence

The whole chain invoices under a single VAT number. The accountant confirmed that the law then wants one unbroken sequence per year across all clinics: per-clinic counters would produce duplicate numbers under the same VAT number.

## Display

The clinic code is only printed next to the number, it is not part of it.

events.message: feat(numbering): single chain-wide counter reset each year
feat(numbering): print clinic code next to the number

files.src/numbering/format.ts:
export const displayNumber = (n: number, year: number, clinicCode: string) =>
  `${year}/${String(n).padStart(5, "0")} (${clinicCode})`;

events.message: test(numbering): clinic code is display only

files.docs/glossary.md:
# Glossary

- **Clinic**: one of the chain's practices.
- **Owner**: the person who pays.
- **Patient**: the animal treated.
- **Visit**: one appointment, billed as one invoice.
- **Balance**: what is still owed on an invoice.
- **Credit note**: the document that refunds part of an invoice.

# vetbill

Invoicing backend for the clinics of the chain.

`npm test` runs the suite.

## Tax categories

- consultation: 22%
- medication: 10%
- pet food: 22%
